result:
The file and shell tools are built and merged to `michael/dev`, and `node Servex/ext/remote/RemoteMCP.test.mjs` passes. They don't load until Servex restarts, and I didn't restart it because of the call. I didn't post this on the card or log it in `task.jsonl`.

- **Tools:** `read_file`, `write_file`, `edit_file`, `list_dir`, `glob` and `shell` are in the shared registry (`Servex/files.js`). `shell` runs Git Bash by default or PowerShell, with a timeout and exit code. All six take an optional `root`, a worktree name or a full path, and default to the monorepo.
- **JSONL:** `write_file` and `edit_file` refuse any `.jsonl` file and point at `.claude/hooks/append.mjs`.
- **Fewer approvals:** I added a generic `call({tool, args})` tool whose schema never changes, so tools added later should be reachable without a new approval. `call({tool:"list"})` returns every tool with its schema. I couldn't test whether the Claude app re-asks approval when the tool list changes, so that part is still unknown. A `list_changed` notification isn't possible because the endpoint has no stream to send it on.
- **Doc:** `Servex/ext/remote/doc/remote-tools.md`, linked from the remote readme.
- **Coordination:** I couldn't message helper-tool-collapse (the tool refused). My only edits to shared code are two lines in `Servex/agents/Global.js`, so a conflict with its reshaping should be easy to spot.
